description: Publish the latest rule ruleset. Runs tests first and refuses if they fail unless force=true. Auto-deprecates previous active ruleset.

force.description: Publish even if tests are not all passing

label.description: Human-readable label for this ruleset version, e.g. 'v5 — raw facts, date arithmetic'. Stored on the ruleset and shown in aethis_list_rulesets.

name.description: Override the human-readable section name for this ruleset. When omitted, the ruleset keeps the name set at generation time (a titlecase of section_id, e.g. 'english_language' → 'English Language'). Section names are surfaced in rulebook responses so end users can see which sections compose a rulebook.

name: aethis_publish
